title: Splices.
officialText:
Splices between concrete and steel or wood sections shall be designed to prevent separation both before and after
the concrete portion has set, and to ensure the alignment and transmission of the total pile load. Splices shall be designed to resist
uplift caused by upheaval during driving of adjacent piles, and shall develop the full compressive strength and not less than 50 percent
of the tension and bending strength of the weaker section.
